text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone has been putting so much effort lately
into both ramen research and training!"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Please allow me to continue
supporting you from behind the scenes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems her sincere attitude earned at least some praise!
